scope: Fresh source-only peer review of the six proposed cases. No Chrome, native engine, backend, database, build, or release execution; no canonical inventory edit. Verdicts judge procedure quality, never runtime behavior.

by_case.EXT-F-4124-T01: PARTIAL: direct-runner limitation is correct; the future agent-run suite has no reproducible command path and clear_done can erase baseline completed todos.
by_case.EXT-F-4127-T01: PASS_FOR_BOUNDED_PROPOSAL: health and empty-command checks fit the current native bridge, contingent on a paired owned engine; privileged dispatcher approval remains untested.
by_case.EXT-F-4128-T01: PARTIAL: the prompt forbids the read-only tool use needed to inspect each fixture label; Tasks is the parallel-runs panel location, absent from the steps.
by_case.EXT-F-4130-T01: PARTIAL: dynamic schema/guide dependency is honestly blocked, but 25 controls lack distinct executable inputs and outcomes, and cleanup/version ordering is underspecified.
by_case.EXT-F-4150-T01: PARTIAL: screenshot side effects and result form are misstated; the inert heading cannot prove focus/blur, and the malformed tab ID produces a parse error rather than a tab lookup error.
by_case.EXT-F-4160-T01: PASS_FOR_BOUNDED_PROPOSAL: eight synthetic text/availability inputs and conditional image fixture cover the current action enum. Runtime capability, image control, and model results remain unverified.

by_case.EXT-F-4124-T01: PARTIAL: honest NOT_EXECUTABLE state, but clear_done cleanup is not case scoped.
by_case.EXT-F-4127-T01: PASS: no shell command, mutation, or phantom permission pass proposed.
by_case.EXT-F-4128-T01: PARTIAL: owned tabs and model-cost caveat are sound; success could be inferred from metadata without actually reading fixture labels.
by_case.EXT-F-4130-T01: PARTIAL: current server contract is rightly required; proposed cleanup must account for every created proposal/version and must not delete an unrelated baseline.
by_case.EXT-F-4150-T01: FAIL: screenshot defaults to persistent cloud/index writes and the proposed cleanup says none occur. A returned file reference can replace inline image data.
by_case.EXT-F-4160-T01: PASS: no fabricated image or fixed wording assertion; separate availability from functional success.

findings.finding: The screenshot step calls the wrapper with persist:true. take_screenshot writes to cld_files and the screenshot index when persistence succeeds, then the wrapper returns file_id/file_url instead of an inline image. The statement that no network or persistent storage is written and the close-tab-only cleanup are false.
findings.required_change: Use a case-owned organization/storage fixture, record returned file and screenshot IDs, verify the persisted result or explicit inline fallback, and remove only artifacts this case created using a supported product cleanup path. If safe cleanup cannot be proven, hold the screenshot control unexecutable.

findings.finding: The sub_prompt says not to call other tools but requires reading a fixture label. Child request state contains page_title/current_url/current_tab_id and no page label; a model could echo metadata without inspecting the page. The panel is mounted in Tasks, not Tools.
findings.required_change: Permit a named read-only page inspection tool, verify it is available to sub-runs, require each returned label to match the distinct page, and direct the tester to Tasks after capturing the Tools inline result.

findings.finding: clear_done removes every completed todo in the selected conversation, not just the second case-created row. A baseline with completed rows is not protected by the stated procedure. The agent invocation remains a goal, not a reproducible way to issue all six actions with returned IDs.
findings.required_change: Use a new empty disposable conversation or prove baseline has no completed rows immediately before clear_done. Specify how a known authorized agent/mandate issues each action and how tool-call/results are captured; otherwise keep the positive controls blocked. Remove only returned case-owned IDs during cleanup.

findings.finding: The 25-control Records case defers almost all payloads and assertions to a guide not captured here; this is an honest discovery outline, not yet a reproducible procedure for those controls. The suggested record_delete before record_restore_version does not specify a valid remaining target/version or final row state. Proposal actions may create durable objects, while cleanup only says remove or archive where supported.
findings.required_change: After fetching the live guide/schema, record one exact input, expected response/state, ID lineage, and cleanup per control before execution. Restore a case-created version while its target remains valid, then delete the case-created row last. Mark any proposal without a verified inert path and deletion method blocked; do not substitute a general cleanup sentence for that proof.

findings.finding: focus_element returns ok:true even when focused:false. The fixture specifies a noninteractive heading for focus/blur, so both controls can appear to pass without a focus transition. The provided nonnumeric tab_id returns Invalid tab_id, not a tab lookup error; unknown-key Zod behavior is not a rejection test.
findings.required_change: Use a case-owned focusable element and assert document.activeElement before/after focus and blur; use a current numeric but nonexistent tab ID for the lookup branch, and assert Invalid tab_id separately for the malformed string. Provide exact per-action arguments and observable changes, including scrollable area and event counters where needed.

accepted_scope_and_limits: All six inventory control-ID sets match their listed inventory features; no control is evidenced as run or passed by this patch.

Tools Run directly invokes local handlers with conversationId=null and skips dispatch approval. Records uses live /tools/test/list and authenticated /tools/test/execute; these routes cannot establish agent binding, chat persistence, or role/permission gates.

desktop_run_command health, parallel_for_each_tab, Records, computer, and user_todos may remain NOT_EXECUTABLE until the stated owned fixtures and live contract exist. AI text inputs are proposed only; describe_image remains fixture-blocked.

The earlier EXT-F-4124 peer review already accepted its null-conversation limitation; this review adds the clear_done baseline hazard. No guest/member/admin observation, service availability, or release identity was produced here.
